PhotoBackup.title: PhotoBackup
PhotoBackup.description: Cloud-backed geotagged photo metadata and compressed JPEG preview belonging to a signed-in user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this backup.

latitude.description: Optional GPS latitude in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Optional GPS longitude in decimal degrees.

accuracyMeters.description: Optional horizontal GPS accuracy in meters.

customNote.description: Optional field note stamped on the photo.

templateName.description: Stamp template name used when capturing.

width.description: Original captured image width in pixels.

height.description: Original captured image height in pixels.

thumbnailBase64.description: Compressed JPEG backup image encoded in Base64.

createdAt.description: Server-generated creation timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server-generated update timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/photo_backups/{backupId}.description: Per-user cloud backup archive of captured geotagged photos.
